question: Build a peer comp table for four analog and mixed-signal semiconductor companies: Texas Instruments, Analog Devices, Microchip Technology and NXP Semiconductors. Alignment rule: for each company use its own fiscal quarter that ended between April 1, 2026 and July 31, 2026 (inclusive); do not calendarize or move any company to a different quarter. Each company has exactly one such quarter. For that quarter report, using GAAP figures from the company's SEC filings as of October 3, 2026: (1) revenue in USD millions; (2) year-over-year revenue growth in % versus the same fiscal quarter a year earlier; (3) gross margin in % = gross profit / revenue; (4) operating margin in % = GAAP operating income / revenue. Also state the fiscal quarter label and quarter-end date used for each company.
grading: Graded cell by cell: each value within tolerance and for the stated period; a missing cell counts as wrong.
answer:
Peer comp, each company's own fiscal quarter ending Apr 1-Jul 31, 2026 (GAAP):
| Row | Revenue | YoY revenue growth | Gross margin | Operating margin |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Texas Instruments (Q2 FY2026, ended 2026-06-30) | 5,463.0 | 22.82% | 61.36% | 42.28% |
| Analog Devices (Q2 FY2026, ended 2026-05-02) | 3,623.5 | 37.25% | 67.33% | 38.08% |
| Microchip Technology (Q1 FY2027, ended 2026-06-30) | 1,484.7 | 38.05% | 63.24% | 22.68% |
| NXP Semiconductors (Q2 FY2026, ended 2026-06-28) | 3,496.0 | 19.48% | 57.27% | 30.64% |

# Peer Comp Table — Analog & Mixed-Signal Semiconductors

**Alignment basis:** Each company's own fiscal quarter ending within Apr 1 – Jul 31, 2026 (no calendarization). All figures are GAAP, per SEC filings / earnings releases (as of Oct 3, 2026).

| Company | Fiscal Quarter | Quarter-End Date | Revenue ($M) | YoY Rev Growth | Gross Margin | GAAP Operating Margin |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Texas Instruments (TXN) | Q2 2026 | Jun 30, 2026 | 5,463 | +22.8% | 61.4% | 42.3% |
| Analog Devices (ADI) | Q2 FY2026 | May 2, 2026 | 3,623 | +37.3% | 67.3% | 38.1% |
| Microchip Technology (MCHP) | Q1 FY2027 | Jun 30, 2026 | 1,484.7 | +38.0% | 63.2% | 22.7% |
| NXP Semiconductors (NXPI) | Q2 2026 | Jun 28, 2026 | 3,496 | +19.5% | 57.3% | 30.6% |

## Supporting detail

**Texas Instruments — Q2 2026 (ended June 30, 2026)**
- Revenue $5,463M vs. $4,448M in Q2 2025 → +22.8%
- Gross profit $3,352M → 61.4% margin
- Operating profit $2,310M → 42.3% margin

**Analog Devices — Q2 FY2026 (ended May 2, 2026)**
- Revenue $3,623.5M vs. $2,640.1M → +37.3%
- Gross margin $2,439.8M → 67.3% margin
- GAAP operating income $1,379.7M (GAAP opex $1,060.1M; non-GAAP/adjusted operating income was $1,774M / 49.0% — GAAP is used here) → 38.1% margin

**Microchip Technology — Q1 FY2027 (ended June 30, 2026)**
- Net sales $1,484.7M vs. $1,075.5M → +38.0%
- GAAP gross profit $938.9M → 63.2% margin (non-GAAP 63.8%)
- GAAP operating income $336.8M → 22.7% margin (non-GAAP 35.1%)

**NXP Semiconductors — Q2 2026 (ended June 28, 2026)**
- Revenue $3,496M vs. $2,926M → +19.5%
- GAAP gross profit $2,002M → 57.3% margin (non-GAAP 58.0%)
- GAAP operating income $1,071M → 30.6% margin (non-GAAP 35.1%)

## Sources
- TI Q2 2026 results: https://investor.ti.com/news-releases/news-release-details/ti-reports-second-quarter-2026-financial-results-and-shareholder
- ADI Q2 FY2026 results: https://www.analog.com/en/newsroom/press-releases/2026/5-20-2026-adi-reports-record-fiscal-second-quarter-2026-financial-results.html
- Microchip Q1 FY2027 results: https://ir.microchip.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/1409/microchip-technology-announces-financial-results-for-first-quarter-of-fiscal-year-2027
- NXP Q2 2026 results: https://investors.nxp.com/news-releases/news-release-details/nxp-semiconductors-reports-second-quarter-2026-results

**Note:** Analog Devices' GAAP operating income is derived as gross margin less GAAP operating expenses (the company headlines non-GAAP operating margin of 49.0%); the 38.1% GAAP operating margin and ~$1.38B GAAP operating income are corroborated by its Q2 FY2026 disclosures. All other figures are directly as reported.
